market_question: Will the UK designate the IRGC a terrorist organization by June 30?
reasoning: The UK Labour government, elected in July 2024 with a large majority, explicitly pledged to proscribe the IRGC. Senior officials including the PM and Foreign Secretary have since signaled they are moving toward designation. With over a year until the deadline and robust cross-party support, the political and legal path is clear, making formal proscription highly likely.
evidence_points: Labour’s 2024 manifesto promised to proscribe the IRGC as a terrorist organization.
Foreign Secretary David Lammy publicly stated the government is actively considering proscription.
The UK has already proscribed other Islamist groups (e.g., Hamas, Hezbollah) and faces minimal diplomatic cost compared to the benefit of aligning with key allies.
sources_consulted: Reuters/BBC reporting on UK IRGC proscription prospects
